overview: Exports a K3s kubeconfig file with your chosen server address replacing 127.0.0.1 — for remote kubectl access from your laptop or CI. Does not auto-detect IP; you enter the address explicitly.
prerequisites: Server address reachable from where you run kubectl (public IP or DNS)

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-kubeconfig

steps.title: Export kubeconfig
steps.body: Prompts for server address and output file path.

steps.title: Use remotely
steps.body: Copy the file to your machine and set KUBECONFIG.

commands.description: Write kubeconfig with your chosen server address

notes: Ensure port 6443 is allowed from your IP (himosoft-firewall)
Treat exported kubeconfig as sensitive — restrict file permissions
